instances.name: TFFM Website
instances.description: Government museum website inaugurated by the Prime Minister of India
instances.details: Public website for the Chhattisgarh Tribal Ministry's museum platform, inaugurated by the Prime Minister of India with 2,000+ organic visits on day one. React frontend and Node.js backend for ticketing APIs, content management and Firebase-based admin workflows, kept up with Nginx process management and automated health monitoring. Releases run through GitHub Actions with self-hosted runners and Ansible. Passed the government-mandated security audit after post-pentest hardening, coordinating with NIC on-ground.

instances.name: TFFM Ticketing Software
instances.description: Flutter Windows ticketing kiosk for the museum, built from scratch
instances.details: Flutter-based Windows ticketing kiosk for the museum, built from scratch with thermal printing, offline Hive storage and real-time sync with the website's ticketing APIs. Processes 100+ tickets a day in production, with kiosk releases automated through the same GitHub Actions and Ansible pipeline as the website.

instances.name: Hackoverse Edu
instances.description: EdTech SaaS with live classes, payments, and course management
instances.details: Flutter frontend with AWS ECS Fargate backend, RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache for session management, and Cashfree payment gateway integration.

instances.name: CG Police Crime Monitoring
instances.description: Crime monitoring platform for Chhattisgarh Police
instances.details: Full production stack for a crime-reporting platform used by 250+ police officers across 10 stations and 5+ sub-divisions in Chhattisgarh. Provisioned end to end with Terraform and Ansible, with the backend and database isolated in private subnets behind a public ALB with TLS. Held 99%+ uptime across 15 production releases in 6 months, with observability through Prometheus, Grafana and Loki, and cut compute costs 38% by moving to 1-year Reserved pricing.

instances.name: IIIT NR Attendance App
instances.description: IoT-based attendance system, Indian Patent IN 589608
instances.details: Flutter + Firebase attendance app using IoT hardware that marks attendance for a whole class in under 5 seconds, at any scale. Proximity-based verification with MAC address randomization and dual-band Wi-Fi signal strength checks makes presence hard to spoof, and it works fully offline during verification. Granted Indian Patent IN 589608 on 18 May 2026.

instances.name: AWS Easy Deploy
instances.description: Open-source Go CLI giving an App Runner-like experience on Elastic Beanstalk
instances.details: Open-source Go CLI that delivers an App Runner-like experience on Elastic Beanstalk for hackathons and small startups. A single init command generates all required AWS deployment resources and a reusable team config file in under 2 minutes, with environment reload automation, avoiding the 40 to 60% runtime cost overhead of AWS App Runner.

instances.name: OpenCAI: Open Cloud AI
instances.description: White-labelled AIOps/FinOps platform with an AI agent for cloud operations
instances.details: OpenCAI (Open Cloud AI) is a white-labelled AIOps/FinOps platform where Administrators manage client organisations, their cloud workspaces and operator accounts. Operators chat with an AI agent that runs cloud-operations and cost-analysis commands for a chosen workspace, in sandboxed containers and only after the operator confirms them.

instances.name: Aarambh: IIIT NR Sports Fest
instances.description: Official website for IIIT Naya Raipur's annual sports event
instances.details: Website for Aarambh, the annual sports event at IIIT Naya Raipur, with live scores, event schedules, team standings and a photo gallery. Next.js frontend with a Node.js/Express API and PostgreSQL via Prisma; deployment config for AWS Amplify.

instances.name: IIIT-NR Admission Portal
instances.description: Official admission portal of IIIT Naya Raipur, built end to end
instances.details: The institute's official admission portal, designed and built end to end with Next.js, PostgreSQL and Prisma, serving prospective students during live admission cycles. Deployed on an on-premise server with Ansible and self-hosted GitHub Actions CI/CD, including database provisioning and infrastructure setup. Includes a mini document management system with secure upload, storage and access controls, and a RAG-based admissions chatbot hardened against prompt injection with input sanitization, strict input delimiting and output filtering.

instances.name: IIIT-NR App
instances.description: Ground-up rebuild of the official campus app with a hardened architecture
instances.details: Found critical security vulnerabilities in the official campus app (1,000+ installs, 750+ active users) through reverse engineering, which led to an institute-commissioned rebuild. The new Flutter app has Google Sign-In and OTP authentication and role-based dashboards for students, wardens, guards and the chairman using Riverpod and GoRouter, backed by a Node.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL API. Codemagic CI/CD covers Android and iOS, self-hosted GitHub Actions runners deploy the web build, and Ansible provisions the production server. Currently in beta ahead of the institute relaunch.

instances.name: VibeCheck
instances.description: YouTube comment sentiment tool, runner-up at E-Summit Hackathon 2025
instances.details: Tool that cuts through a YouTube comments section to give clear, summarized sentiment insights. Built with the YouTube API and a Gemini model, it classifies comments, generates summaries and offers content improvement tips for creators, with a chatbot for a deeper breakdown of audience sentiment. Runner-up at E-Summit Hackathon 2025.
